hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(rm -rf /|--force.*origin.*main|git push.*--force|docker system prune.*--all.*--force)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command detected. Please review and confirm before running destructive operations.' && exit 2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '(\.env$|\.env\.production|credentials\.json|secrets\.)'; then echo 'WARNING: Editing sensitive file. Ensure no secrets are hardcoded.' >&2; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(go)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(rs)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ] && [ -f "$(dirname "$file")/../../Cargo.toml" ]; then (cd "$(dirname "$file")/../.." && cargo fmt --quiet 2>/dev/null || true); fi; done; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(py)$'; then for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then black "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE 'services/.*\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then echo 'Running ESLint...' >&2; for file in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then service_dir=$(echo "$file" | grep -oE 'services/[^/]+'); if [ -d "$service_dir" ] && [ -f "$service_dir/package.json" ]; then (cd "$service_dir" && npx eslint --fix "${file#$service_dir/}" 2>/dev/null || true); fi; fi; done; fi
